'''2016 European Championship Day 2 Martin den Boef LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Martin den Boef]] at [[2016 European Championship]] (Day 2).

* '''Player:''' [[Martin den Boef]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
